digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output selection and schema compilation
propositions: An exact-model-id row added to _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES flipped us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 from PromptedOutput to NativeOutput, causing rebar to send Bedrock JSON schemas that exceed Anthropic's 24-optional-parameter and 180-second grammar compilation limits

Plan-review and code-review Pass-2 verification steps fail with HTTP 400 after 180-185 seconds when the verification contract (22-36 optional parameters) exceeds the provider's documented schema complexity bounds for constrained decoding
The prerequisite_verify step cannot complete, degrading every finding to no-verification and preventing plan review attestation from being signed, despite blocking-finding count being zero

output_mode must gate NativeOutput on both runtime stack capability (whether botocore/boto3 supports outputConfig) and measured schema complexity (recursive optional-parameter count across $defs and nested properties), not model capability alone

Two failure variants occur: Variant A (Bedrock 400 after 185s compilation timeout on newer botocore) and Variant B (boto3 0.0s client-side rejection of outputConfig parameter on botocore 1.40.61), both caused by the same over-scoped native capability row
Fallback from NativeOutput to PromptedOutput on schema-complexity rejection must be logged distinctly and used only once per request, as retrying an identical over-complexity request is futile
